title: The ordinary ambient exceptional adjoint
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Let $f:X\to S$ admit a compactification
$X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{r}S$ between
Noetherian schemes, with $j$ open and $r$ proper of finite
type. The ambient functor $Rf_!=Rr_*j_!$ on ordinary derived
categories of etale $A$-module sheaves has a right adjoint,
denoted $f^\times$. No restriction to a constructible
subcategory is made in this assertion.
The notation refers to ordinary derived categories, and ordinary etale compact supports.

proof.text: For each $T=X,\overline X,S$, use a small presentation of the small etale site in a common indexing universe, with its constant ring sheaf $A_T$. By [lem-pur-ringed-site-grothendieck-abelian], $\mathcal A_T=\Mod(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ is Grothendieck abelian. By [lem-kun-grothendieck-derived-coproducts], arbitrary set-indexed coproducts in $D(\mathcal A_T)$ are represented by termwise coproducts of complexes, including the empty coproduct.

By [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact], $j_!$ is exact, and [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated] makes its degreewise descent $Dj_!$ triangulated. By [lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-adjunction], $j_!\dashv j^{-1}$. For every family $(F_i)$ and sheaf $G$, the adjunction gives $\Hom(j_!(\bigoplus_iF_i),G)\cong\prod_i\Hom(F_i,j^{-1}G)\cong\prod_i\Hom(j_!F_i,G)$; these bijections identify the canonical coprojections, so $j_!$ preserves coproducts. Apply this degreewise and use [lem-kun-grothendieck-derived-coproducts] on both sites to conclude that $Dj_!$ preserves arbitrary derived coproducts.

Use the K-injective model of $Rr_*$ specified in [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. Here is the exactness check, rather than identifying the underived homotopy functor with its derived functor. By [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist] and [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived], the first arrow of any distinguished triangle can be represented by a chain map $I\to J$ of K-injective resolutions. Its cone is K-injective: for any acyclic $B$, the Hom complex $\operatorname{Hom}^\bullet(B,\operatorname{Cone}(I\to J))$ is the cone of a map between the acyclic Hom complexes for $I,J$, hence acyclic, by [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions]. Thus the whole triangle is computed by this cone triangle of K-injectives. Degreewise $r_*$ respects shifts and the cone matrix, as recorded in [def-amb-etale-compact-support]; consequently $Rr_*$ sends this triangle to the corresponding cone triangle and is exact. Since $A$ is finite and $r$ is proper of finite type between Noetherian schemes, [lem-amb-proper-coproducts] gives preservation of arbitrary coproducts. Therefore $Rf_!^c=Rr_*Dj_!$ is exact and preserves coproducts for the fixed compactification $c=(j,r)$.

Apply [lem-grothendieck-derived-brown-right-adjoint] with source $D(\mathcal A_X)$ and target $D(\mathcal A_S)$ to the exact coproduct-preserving functor $Rf_!^c$ of the preceding steps. It supplies a right adjoint $f^\times$ on the whole ordinary unbounded derived category. No boundedness or constructibility hypothesis is used. The assertion concerns this fixed compactification and does not require comparison isomorphisms between different compactifications.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $f:X\to S$ admit a compactification
$X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{r}S$ between
Noetherian schemes, with $j$ open and $r$ proper of finite
type. The ambient functor $Rf_!=Rr_*j_!$ on ordinary derived
categories of etale $A$-module sheaves has a right adjoint,
denoted $f^\times$. No restriction to a constructible
subcategory is made in this assertion.

proof.text:
The extension by zero in [def-amb-etale-compact-support]
is exact and commutes with coproducts, as is checked at geometric
stalks. The fibre dimensions of the fixed finite-type proper
morphism $r$ have a finite bound, so
[lem-amb-proper-coproducts] makes $Rf_!$ an
exact coproduct-preserving functor. Apply the ordinary
Brown representability theorem for the derived category of a
Grothendieck abelian category: an exact functor out of such a
derived category which preserves coproducts has a right adjoint.
Here the abelian category consists of sheaves of $A$-modules;
it is Grothendieck since filtered colimits are exact and the free
module sheaves on a small set of site objects form a generating
set. The precise homological-algebra input is
[Stacks Project,
Proposition 19.15.2, Tag 0F5Y](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0F5Y) (Section 19.15, Brown representability
and Grothendieck abelian categories), about ordinary triangulated
categories.

Representability is applied to the functor
$M\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_!M,K)$, for each $K$.
Yoneda makes the representing objects functorial in $K$,
and the identity of a representing object gives the counit.
The representing bijection then gives the unit, and the two
triangle identities follow by applying that bijection to an
identity map. Finally the coherent comparisons of the left
functors in [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons] give the
corresponding unique comparisons of right adjoints. Thus this
construction makes no additional assumption about $f^\times K$.
